title: 右上挑斩
author: Kingdom Come Combat
first_page: 输入：右、左、右。右击、左击后，再以右击收尾，绕过对手武器。
second_page: 先让敌人跟随你的右路，再用左击拨乱他的防守。最后一击回到右侧，顺势挑开破绽。翻到这里，你已经开始练习右上挑斩。

en_us.title: Lower Right Strike
en_us.first_page: Input: Right, Left, Right. Follow the opening cuts with a final rising strike from the right around the opponent's weapon.
en_us.second_page: Draw the enemy toward your right, disrupt the guard from the left, then return to the right and lift the final cut through the opening.
